sahneler.metin: NASA's first probe to Venus lifted off from Cape Canaveral.
Within minutes it veered off course and was destroyed by range safety.
Its guidance had begun steering erratically.
The problem was in a hand-written equation.
A small bar over one symbol was missing.
That bar meant the data should be smoothed.
Without it, the software reacted to noise.
It became a lesson in checking software before launch.

aciklama:
Mariner 1 veered off course and was destroyed after launch. The cause: unsmoothed velocity data driving erratic steering commands.
